name: Authentication
description: Windows MDM settings in the Authentication category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Allow Aad Password Reset
properties.description: Specifies whether password reset is enabled for AAD accounts.

properties.name: Allow EAP Cert SSO (User)
properties.description: Allows an EAP cert-based authentication for a single sign on (SSO) to access internal resources.

properties.name: Allow Fast Reconnect
properties.description: Allows EAP Fast Reconnect from being attempted for EAP Method TLS. Most restricted value is 0.

properties.name: Allow Secondary Authentication Device
properties.description: Allows secondary authentication devices to work with Windows. The default for this policy must be on for consumer devices (defined as local or Microsoft account connected device) and off for enterprise devices (such as cloud domain-joined, cloud domain-joined in an on-premises only environment, cloud domain-joined in a hybrid environment, and BYOD). In the next major release of Windows 10, the default for this policy for consumer devices will be changed to off. This will only affect users that have not already set up a secondary authentication device.

properties.name: Configure Web Sign In Allowed Urls
properties.description: Specifies a list of URLs that are navigable in Web Sign-in based authentication scenarios.

properties.name: Configure Webcam Access Domain Names
properties.description: Specifies a list of domains that are allowed to access the webcam in Web Sign-in based authentication scenarios.

properties.name: Enable Fast First Sign In
properties.description: Specifies whether new non-admin AAD accounts should auto-connect to pre-created candidate local accounts

enum.description: The feature defaults to the existing SKU and device capabilities.
Enabled. Auto-connect new non-admin Azure AD accounts to pre-configured candidate local accounts
Disabled. Do not auto-connect new non-admin Azure AD accounts to pre-configured local accounts

properties.name: Enable Passwordless Experience
properties.description: Specifies whether connected users on AADJ devices receive a Passwordless experience on Windows

enum.description: The feature defaults to the existing edition and device capabilities.
Enabled. The Passwordless experience will be enabled on Windows
Disabled. The Passwordless experience will not be enabled on Windows

properties.name: Enable Web Sign In
properties.description: Specifies whether web-based sign-in is allowed for signing in to Windows

enum.description: The feature defaults to the existing SKU and device capabilities.
Enabled. Web Sign-in will be enabled for signing in to Windows
Disabled. Web Sign-in will not be enabled for signing in to Windows

properties.name: Preferred Aad Tenant Domain Name
properties.description: Specifies the preferred domain among available domains in the AAD tenant.
